sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Big Systems is a nationally recognized Value-Added Reseller of Wide Format Digital Printing, software, and supplies with over three decades of experience.

Industry: Printing Equipment & Supplies · HQ: Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin · Size: <$50M · Products: Wide Format Printers, Ink & Toner, Print Media, Laminators, Cutters, 3D Printers

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Big Systems scores 61 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (20/30), application fit (24/25) and event engagement (8/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (15% similar on printing, media, print, digital); Drytac (14% similar on media, print, printing, wide); ORAFOL Europe (8% similar on printing, wide, digital, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
